svg.title: The Solar — vertical tower interior
svg.desc: Arrive beneath the private rooms, then climb past the library and ward table to Lyra’s sunlit chamber. A final stair reaches the telescope beneath the glazed dome. Return through the lower tower door.
svg.text: Upper chambers → library mezzanine → lantern crown
